body:
@andrei-mart When you see server crashes, can you also pick up the cause of the crash? Generally, it would be one of the following 3
1. FATAL files -- can check the respective tserver log dirs
1. core files -- path where these show up depends on your core pattern, but likely it's the dir where you started yb-ctl from
1. OOM -- unlikely in a local test

@bmatican @rthallamko3 Still is it expected that timeout above will lead to a fatal? In what cases would that timeout happen?

@def- yes, this type of FATAL should be generic, around some form of DDLs waiting on backgorund operations, then crashing if not done in 60s (gflag), but we hadn't pinned down a concrete easy local repro
